items.title: The tensor product of constructible sheaves of modules on the small etale site is constructible
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the tensor product of two constructible sheaves of Lambda-modules on X_etale is constructible, for Lambda Noetherian (statement lines 11990-11995). The proof is a standard refinement argument: reduce to an affine base, refine the two partitions giving constructibility to a common partition of the same type, and use that on each stratum both sheaves are locally constant, so their tensor product is locally constant by the cited same-chapter statement, pulled back along the stratum inclusion (proof lines 11998-12002). The content is the bookkeeping of the common refinement, which is where the notion of constructibility is used. The claim is H2: one refinement reduction plus one known local statement.
